question: An attacker in an offside position collects the rebound from a defender's goal-line block. What does the referee give?
options: Offside: the block counts as a save
Play on: a deliberate touch resets it
Play on: offside is judged at the rebound
answer: Offside. A deliberate play by a defender normally frees an attacker who was in an offside position, but the Law makes one exception: a save, meaning any attempt to stop a ball going into or very close to the goal. A block on the line is a save, so the attacker is still penalised.
move: Learn the exception before leaning on the rule it breaks.
trap: Knowing that a defender's deliberate touch normally wipes out offside.
source: The FA, Laws of the Game, Law 11
